title: H359 stub: LLM semantic lead-lag filtering for Kalshi/Polymarket event pairs
rationale: arXiv:2602.07048 'LLM as a Risk Manager: LLM Semantic Filtering for Lead-Lag Trading in Prediction Markets' (Feb 2026) proposes a two-stage causal screener: (1) Granger causality identifies candidate leader-follower pairs from market-implied probability time series; (2) LLM semantic stage re-ranks candidates by assessing whether the proposed direction admits a plausible economic transmission mechanism based on event descriptions. This directly extends our prediction market pipeline (Kalshi automated trading, economic nowcasting playbook). Current Kalshi pipeline trades single events in isolation; this paper enables cross-event arbitrage by identifying when one market is a leading indicator for another. Example: FOMC rate decision market leads the 2Y Treasury yield market by 1-3 hours; CPI market leads FOMC expectation market by days. Relevant to H185 (CPI nowcasting), where we're already monitoring related events. Implementation requires Kalshi CLOB history (available via API) and Granger test + one LLM call per candidate pair. Low cost: only pairs that pass Granger at p<0.05 go to LLM stage (~10-20% of candidates).
